script_text: Brace yourself — the cosmos is about to rewrite your Taurus playbook. Monday brings a powerful Venus-Mars conjunction in your 7th House, amplifying love and partnerships, while Mercury trines your ruling planet, sharpening financial instincts. Tuesday feels intense as Pluto squares your 10th House, exposing career power struggles. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, sparking romance and creative breakthroughs. Thursday brings emotional release as the Moon opposes your 4th House, urging you to confront old wounds. Friday’s Jupiter sextile your 2nd House opens unexpected income opportunities — perfect for bold money moves. The weekend calls for grounding as Saturn reminds you of long-term commitments.
